notes: Nothing misstates the guide, but two items are worth a human look. (1) /placementAdvice/5 comes from the 6 October behaviour check, measured in Chrome with react-native-web. The 13 October build (c1fa197) gave each chip maxWidth 100%, flexShrink 1 and minWidth 0, and the row-parent / horizontal-ScrollView case was not re-tested after that. The 'never wraps' wording is the evidence's own, but it may be stale and the item carries no date. (2) /examples/1 passes the applied value as the chip's label (label="Last 30 days", label="UPI"), and its description says 'an applied chip shows its value as its label'. The guide's States section says only that an Active chip 'shows its value'. Whether that happens by swapping the label or through a separate ChipSelect prop is a package-types question I can't check from here; confirm it against ChipSelect's props.
